label: D2 after a1->S1 (common), late in episode (trials 90-99), after an unrewarded trial
explanation: Fires only at D2 (100% of mass), almost only when state S1 is shown (99% of mass) after choosing a1 (96%), i.e. a common a1->S1 transition, and only near the end of the episode: 98% of mass falls in episode trials 90-99, none before trial 80. It coincides with the model value head being low (value < 5.2 holds 99.7% of mass), which is the end-of-episode drop in value. Magnitude is largest on the last trials of the episode (ep_trial >= 95 holds 73% of mass in 43% of predicted steps) and after an unrewarded previous trial (prev_reward == 0 holds 84% of mass). It never fires at D1 or GO, rarely on S2 or on rare a2->S1. D2/S1/a1/late alone gives recall 0.88 but precision 0.30; adding prev_reward == 0 gives the best dev F1 of 0.68 (P 0.67, R 0.70, mass recall 0.83). All variables are observed at D2 (the agent may track time in the episode). It is a conjunction of position-in-episode and the observed transition, with the rest of the precision gap probably in magnitude/time-in-episode gradation.
